tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Certificate Verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled in all builds, development builds included. Development and test environments do not bypass verification; they use self-signed certificates that go through the full verification path, which keeps the security checks active and lets the TLS verification code be tested realistically without depending on real certificate infrastructure.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
tool_input.description: Create the TLS verification policy doc

Dev and test environments use self-signed certificates that go through full verification instead of bypassing it.

The decision comes from two recorded observations. Observation #15 disabled verification in development builds. Observation #16, recorded a minute later, reverses it, so I wrote only #16 and left the retired option out of the file.

I didn't find any TLS policy recorded in the repo's own docs, so the memory observations are the only source.
